data.title: Insurer requests documents for water damage claim
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG asks for a list of damaged items with purchase receipts and photos for your water damage claim of 19 March 2026. Documents are due within 10 working days of the letter date (27 March 2026).
data.explanation: Your home contents insurer needs more information to process your water damage claim. Send a list of the damaged items, proof of purchase (receipts) and photos of the damage. The deadline is 10 working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays) from the letter date; the app shows the exact date. If you don't send them in time, the insurer will decide on the claim based on the existing file (nach Aktenlage), which may be to your disadvantage. If you need more time, contact the insurer early.
